_comment: Ratchet baseline for scripts/check-tag-hygiene.mjs. Every value is a DEFECT COUNT that must not grow. Measured on prod 2026-08-23, BEFORE 20260919100000/110000 (Phase 1.1/1.3) applied — those only improve these numbers, and the ratchet fails on regression, never on improvement. Tighten with `node scripts/check-tag-hygiene.mjs --update` after a cleanup lands; never loosen a number to make CI pass.

_notes.duplicate_active_name: 9 is correct, not a backlog: these are the deliberate mat-* sense splits (mat-leather vs leather) excluded by 20260916110000. Going UP means a real twin pair regrew.
_notes.redirect_to_non_canonical: 301s into a 404. PR #2828 fixed this class once and it has regrown to 58; recorded so the 59th is caught, not so 58 is accepted.
_notes.image_without_license: Grew 1167 -> 1215 during Phase 0, which is why this gate exists. Phase 3 drives it down.
_notes.image_without_alt: WCAG 1.1.1 on every page rendering a tag image. Phase 3.
